lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaMnV₄O₁₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a 36-atom unit cell and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn and V centers each in octahedral coordination with six O neighbors, while Na shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Mn and V octahedra, plus face-sharing between Na polyhedra and both Mn and V octahedra, are observed. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites.
